request: Rename Todo.done to Todo.completed everywhere, and make list hide completed todos by default (includeDone: true shows them).

requests.title: commands > lists, optionally hiding done items
requests.reason: This test asserted that list(todos) with no options shows completed todos ("[x] milk\n[ ] eggs"). The instruction changes the default to hide completed todos, so that assertion can't pass anymore. I changed it to expect list(todos) to return "[ ] eggs" and moved the full-list assertion to list(todos, { includeDone: true }).
